svg.text: Warmth. Aroma. A handi full of character.

g.title: Dum E Biryani — The Aroma Handi concept

svg.text: A rounded handi with a curling aroma plume.

g.title: Dum E Biryani — The Dum Host
g.desc: A smiling host wearing a saffron cloth head wrap holds a warm biryani handi. Expressive lowercase lettering with Odisha beneath.

svg.text: A cheerful host serving a generous pot.
Best fit: hospitality and a friendly personality.

svg.text: A sealed vessel combining the letters D and e.
